recognize_zh: 周邊血液中數顆中小型淋巴樣細胞，染色質中度凝集，胞質少量藍色、邊緣略不規則，右上與右側細胞核有凹陷或不規則輪廓，符合 T 細胞前淋巴球性白血病（T-PLL）；本圖核仁不明顯，屬小細胞變異外觀，需流式確認 T 表型與 TCL1 重排。
features: Several small to medium lymphoid cells, larger than red cells
Round to irregular nuclei, with one cell showing a deeply indented/convoluted contour
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not conspicuous in this field
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm with slightly irregular or blebbed margins
Background red cells with a few target-like forms; no smudge cells visible
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with moderately condensed chromatin, scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm with irregular margins, and nuclear contours ranging from round to deeply indented. Distinct nucleoli are not well visualized, a feature seen in the small-cell variant of T-PLL. No smudge cells or blasts are identified. In conjunction with a mature T-cell immunophenotype (CD4+ or CD4+/CD8+, CD7 bright) and TCL1A or MTCP1 rearrangement, findings are consistent with T-prolymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have cerebriform nuclear folds with CD7 and CD26 loss and erythroderma, whereas T-PLL typically retains strong CD7 and carries inv(14)/t(14;14).
CLL cells have soccer-ball chromatin with smudge cells and are CD19+/CD5+/CD23+, lacking T-cell antigens.
ATLL shows multilobated 'flower cells', is HTLV-1 positive, and is often CD25 bright with CD7 loss.
T-LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and a CD8+/CD57+ cytotoxic phenotype.
